claim: Brent crude closes below $72/barrel on Friday 2026-05-30 as OPEC+ supply fears remain muted despite US-Iran military exchange.
falsification_criteria: Brent crude settlement at or above $72.00/barrel on 2026-05-30 disproves this call.
grading_note: Brent crude traded at $91.12 intraday on May 30, 2026 per OilPrice.com, and settled at $91.70–$92 on May 29, 2026 per Trading Economics; both are far above the $72 falsification threshold, disproving the claim.

claim: USD/JPY falls below 150.00 by 2026-06-05 as HSBC's dual-hike call triggers yen short-covering.
falsification_criteria: USD/JPY trades at or above 150.00 at the New York close on 2026-06-05 disproves this call.
grading_note: USD/JPY closed at 159.95 on June 5, 2026 per Investing.com; falsification threshold of ≥150.00 is clearly met — claim is disproved.

claim: Snowflake (SNOW) closes the week ending 2026-06-05 no more than 20% above its pre-earnings close — giving back at least half of the 37% single-session surge.
falsification_criteria: SNOW closes above a 20% gain versus its pre-earnings level at end of day 2026-06-05 disproves this call.
grading_note: SNOW closed at $245.66 on June 5, 2026, representing a 38.3% gain from its $177.60 pre-earnings close on May 26, well above the 20% falsification threshold; claim that SNOW would hold gains to no more than 20% above pre-earnings was disproven.

claim: The ECB cuts rates by 25bp at its June meeting — market pricing for a pause does not materialise.
falsification_criteria: ECB holds rates unchanged at the June 2026 policy meeting or cuts by more than 25bp — either outcome disproves the call of a clean 25bp cut.
grading_note: Governing council members are counselling patience on pace, not direction — a hold would require a material upside inflation surprise that current data does not support. The path of least resistance is a 25bp cut with hawkish forward guidance.

claim: BP shares (LON: BP) close June 28 below 350p — governance turmoil and stalled Whiting talks prevent any sustained recovery.
falsification_criteria: BP closes at or above 350p on 2026-06-28 on the London Stock Exchange disproves this call.
grading_note: A board-level public war plus unresolved labour action at a flagship refinery creates two independent overhangs. At multi-year lows, the stock needs a clear catalyst — absent a deal or chair resolution, mean reversion is unlikely.

claim: The UK-India free trade deal is formally signed or announced as concluded before 2026-06-28.
falsification_criteria: No formal signing or official conclusion announcement is made by either government by close of business 2026-06-28 disproves this call.
grading_note: Negotiators signalling 'final stretch' is a familiar diplomatic posture that regularly precedes months of further delay. The contrarian call here is that the deadline pressure is real and political will on both sides closes remaining gaps.

claim: WTI crude closes below $70/bbl on Monday 2026-05-31 as Iran ceasefire optimism and Hormuz reopening chatter outweigh weekend risk premium.
falsification_criteria: WTI front-month settles at or above $70.00/bbl on 2026-05-31.
grading_note: WTI crude closed at $87.36/bbl on May 29, 2026 per Trading Economics; falsification threshold of $70/bbl was exceeded by $17.36/bbl — prediction falsified.

claim: XLE underperforms SPY by at least 1.5 percentage points on a total-return basis for the week ending 2026-06-06.
falsification_criteria: XLE's total return for the week ending 2026-06-06 is within 1.5 pp of SPY or exceeds it.
grading_note: XLE returned +2.452% vs SPY −2.502% for the week ending 2026-06-05 per ETF snapshot; XLE outperformed by 4.954 pp, not underperformed by 1.5 pp.

claim: EUR/USD trades above 1.0950 at the 4 pm NY fix on 2026-06-04 as dollar softness from Bessent's Fed-accountability rhetoric and a risk-on tape weigh on the greenback.
falsification_criteria: EUR/USD 4 pm NY fix on 2026-06-04 is at or below 1.0950.
grading_note: EUR/USD closed at 1.1606 on June 4, 2026 per Investing.com; prediction threshold of 1.0950 was clearly exceeded — proven.

claim: Shutterfly's new bond offering prices at a yield-to-worst above 11% — market demands a double-digit coupon to absorb $1.875B of junk paper from a distressed capital structure.
falsification_criteria: Shutterfly's new senior secured notes price with a yield-to-worst at or below 11.00%.
grading_note: Shutterfly's $1.15B senior secured notes offering was announced May 29, 2026 with June 10 expected close; specific yield-to-worst or coupon at pricing not publicly available as of June 7, 2026. The deal had not yet closed as of the target date (June 6, 2026).

claim: The S&P 500 posts a down week for the week ending 2026-06-06, ending the nine-week winning streak, as breadth deterioration catches up to the index.
falsification_criteria: SPX closes on 2026-06-06 at or above its 2026-05-30 closing level.
grading_note: S&P 500 closed at 7,383.74 on June 5, 2026 (the final trading day of the week), down 196.32 points from 7,580.06 on May 29, 2026; falsifier requires close at or above the May 29 level, which was clearly not met per market data.

claim: AstraZeneca (AZN) gains at least 3% from its 2026-05-30 close by 2026-06-27 as the Imfinzi FDA approval catalyzes upgrades and the bladder-cancer label expansion is priced into consensus estimates.
falsification_criteria: AZN closes below a 3% gain relative to its 2026-05-30 close at any point through 2026-06-27, or closes below that threshold on 2026-06-27.
grading_note: FDA approvals in oncology with Phase III data supporting a significant reduction in disease progression historically re-rate the stock over the following month; the BCG-naïve NMIBC population is large and underpenetrated.

claim: WBD (Warner Bros. Discovery) common equity closes down ≥3% on 2026-06-01 as Paramount LBO debt friction triggers fresh skepticism about deal completion.
falsification_criteria: WBD closes flat or higher on June 1st, or closes down less than 3% from May 31st close.
grading_note: WBD closed at $27.01 on June 1, 2026, flat from May 29 close of $27.01 (0% change); required ≥3% decline per prediction criteria. Per TradingHours.com/NYSE calendar, May 31 was Sunday (market closed), making May 29 the relevant baseline.

claim: GSK closes above £16.50 on the London Stock Exchange by 2026-06-06, recovering at least 4% from its current depressed level.
falsification_criteria: GSK closes at or below £16.50 on June 6th.
grading_note: GSK closed at 1,938 pence (£19.38) on June 5, 2026 (the last trading day before the target date of June 6, 2026, which fell on a Saturday), per Investing.com historical data. The closing price exceeded the £16.50 threshold by 17.2%, well above the 4% recovery minimum claimed — proven.

claim: Sea Limited (SE) trades above $130 by end of day 2026-06-06 as the analyst price-target revision cycle draws in momentum buyers following Q1 strength.
falsification_criteria: SE closes at or below $130 on June 6th.
grading_note: SE closed at $78.85 on June 6, 2026 per Yahoo Finance; the prediction required a close above $130, so the falsification criteria (close at or below $130) is clearly met.

claim: EUR/USD breaks above 1.0950 and holds that level on a daily close at least once between 2026-06-02 and 2026-06-07.
falsification_criteria: EUR/USD does not post a daily close above 1.0950 at any point from June 2nd through June 7th.
grading_note: EUR/USD closed at 1.1649 (Jun 2), 1.1614 (Jun 3), 1.1640 (Jun 4-5) per ECB data; all closes well above 1.0950 threshold — proven.

claim: Erewhon's landlord lawsuit results in a public settlement or rent-deferral agreement announced before 2026-06-30, with no store closure.
falsification_criteria: No settlement or deferral agreement is publicly announced by June 30th, OR the Culver City store closes.
grading_note: Luxury grocery brands treat real-estate disputes as reputation risks; Erewhon's brand equity makes a quiet settlement far cheaper than a protracted public fight. Landlords of premium tenants also prefer curing arrears over vacancy.

claim: The U.S. HY-IG credit spread (ICE BofA indices) widens by ≥15 basis points from its May 31st level before June 30th, driven by leveraged-deal supply indigestion.
falsification_criteria: The HY-IG spread on any day through June 30th never exceeds the May 31st level by 15 bps or more.
grading_note: A $110bn LBO financing attempt forcing aggressive terms into a resistant debt market is exactly the kind of supply shock that tips HY spreads wider. June is seasonally weak for new issuance absorption.

claim: AUD/NZD closes below 1.0800 on 2026-06-02 as RBNZ hawkish repricing continues to squeeze crowded long-AUD positions.
falsification_criteria: AUD/NZD closes at or above 1.0800 on 2026-06-02.
grading_note: AUD/NZD closed at 1.2067 on 2026-06-02 per Investing.com; falsifier requires ≥1.0800 — clearly satisfied, claim is wrong.

claim: BP shares (LON: BP) fall at least 2% by 2026-06-05 as the permanent chair search signals prolonged governance uncertainty to institutional holders.
falsification_criteria: BP shares close less than 2% below their 2026-06-01 closing price on every day through 2026-06-05.
grading_note: BP closed 535.90 GBX on June 1, 2026 and ranged from 536.60-545.50 GBX June 2-4, all more than 2% above the June 1 close, per Investing.com historical data.

claim: JEPI's weekly net inflows for the period ending 2026-06-06 come in below $500m as the covered-call drag becomes visible in a continued equity rally.
falsification_criteria: JEPI reports net inflows of $500m or more for the week ending 2026-06-06 per ETF flow data.
grading_note: JEPI's 5-day net flows as of June 5, 2026 were $123.41 million per ETF Database; well below the $500m falsification threshold, confirming the claim.

claim: Cigna (CI) underperforms the S&P 500 Health Care sector ETF (XLV) by at least 3 percentage points on a total-return basis by 2026-06-08.
falsification_criteria: CI's total return from 2026-06-01 close to 2026-06-08 close trails XLV's total return by less than 3 percentage points.
grading_note: Barclays' downgrade to Equal Weight with a PBM-transition execution risk thesis gives institutional sellers fresh cover; sector-relative underperformance is the cleanest expression of that single-stock risk being repriced.

claim: Gallium spot price (99.99% purity, China domestic) rises above $800/kg by 2026-07-01 as Beijing's export throttle bites into spot availability.
falsification_criteria: Gallium spot price remains at or below $800/kg through 2026-07-01 per SMM or Fastmarkets data.
grading_note: China controlling roughly 80% of refined gallium output means export restrictions translate directly into spot scarcity; the simultaneous consumer-brand acquisition spree signals Beijing is comfortable escalating on strategic materials while softening optics elsewhere.

claim: BT Group (LON: BT.A) closes June no higher than 5% above its 2026-06-01 price, confirming the market's refusal to credit the earnings quality improvement.
falsification_criteria: BT.A closes more than 5% above its 2026-06-01 closing price on any day on or before 2026-07-01.
grading_note: When strong earnings quality fails to move a share price, the burden of proof shifts to the growth narrative — which BT has not yet delivered. Without a catalyst (M&A, dividend surprise, or macro rotation into UK telcos), the disconnect persists.

claim: Brent crude gives back at least half of today's 8% gain, closing below $88/bbl on Wednesday June 3.
falsification_criteria: Brent crude front-month settles at or above $88/bbl on June 3.
grading_note: Brent crude settled at $97.11/bbl on June 3, 2026 per Trading Economics; falsification criterion requires settlement at or above $88/bbl — clearly met.

claim: Fluence Energy (FLNC) closes at least 15% below its June 2 intraday peak by Friday June 5, as the Siemens-Nvidia partnership hype fades.
falsification_criteria: FLNC closes within 15% of its June 2 intraday high on any session through June 5.
grading_note: FLNC closed $24.05 on June 4 (19.8% below the June 2 intraday peak of $29.97); both June 3 ($24.81, -17.2%) and June 4 closes were well below the falsification threshold of $25.47, confirming the prediction per search results and Yahoo Finance data.

claim: GBP/USD breaks above 1.2950 by end of week June 6, as easyJet bid speculation and softer US data lift sterling against a geopolitically-pressured dollar.
falsification_criteria: GBP/USD fails to close above 1.2950 on any session through June 6.
grading_note: GBP/USD closed at 1.3341 on Friday, June 5, 2026 (last trading day of the week) per poundsterlinglive historical data; threshold of 1.2950 was cleared by over 380 pips—proven.

claim: IBM closes below its June 2 settlement price before June 9, surrendering the Barclays-driven 9% rally within the week.
falsification_criteria: IBM closes at or above its June 2 settlement price on every session through June 9.
grading_note: Single-analyst initiations that move a large-cap 9% in a day are rarely sustained — institutional sellers use the liquidity. IBM's secular growth story is not new; Barclays' framing adds no incremental earnings catalyst.

claim: The VIX closes below 16 at least once before June 20, as Iran ceasefire noise resolves without a genuine supply shock.
falsification_criteria: VIX does not close below 16 on any session from June 3 through June 20.
grading_note: Iran risk premiums built on unconfirmed Trump posts are inherently fragile. If any deal language materialises — even partial — the vol bid collapses. The S&P's underlying bid from software and AI names provides a floor that keeps realized vol contained.

claim: AstraZeneca shares close above £130 (London) at least once before July 2, as the Imfinzi liver cancer data attracts fresh oncology fund flows.
falsification_criteria: AZN.L fails to close above £130 on any session from June 3 through July 2.
grading_note: Positive Phase III survival data in a large-indication cancer (HCC) is a durable re-rating event, not a one-day trade. The $40bn oncology target gives sell-side desks a narrative peg; fund rebalancing into the name should provide a sustained bid.

claim: Fluence Energy (FLNC) gives back at least 15% of today's surge and closes below $28 by end of day 2026-06-04.
falsification_criteria: Falsified if FLNC closes at or above $28.00 on 2026-06-04.
grading_note: FLNC closed at $27.15 on 2026-06-04 per Yahoo Finance, below the $28.00 falsification threshold; the prediction's claim is correct.

claim: Marvell Technology (MRVL) closes below its 2026-06-03 record high by 2026-06-06, ending the week down from today's close.
falsification_criteria: Falsified if MRVL closes on 2026-06-06 at or above its 2026-06-03 closing price.
grading_note: MRVL closed at $263.47 on Friday June 5 (final trading day before target date), down 16.74% from Thursday, falling below both the June 3 record high of $324.20 and June 3 closing price of $301.65; falsifier requires ≥$301.65 — not met per StockAnalysis historical data.

claim: WTI crude front-month futures close below $72.00 at least once between 2026-06-04 and 2026-06-10.
falsification_criteria: Falsified if WTI front-month settles at or above $72.00 on every trading day from 2026-06-04 through 2026-06-10.
grading_note: The inventory draw was a one-week signal; US-Iran deal speculation, if it materialises into a framework, would swamp the bullish inventory read and press prices below near-term support.

claim: The S&P 500 fails to extend its winning streak to nine days — the index closes lower on 2026-06-04.
falsification_criteria: Falsified if the S&P 500 posts a positive close on 2026-06-04, extending the streak to nine days.
grading_note: S&P 500 closed at 7,553.68 on June 4, 2026, down 0.74%, failing to extend the winning streak to nine days — prediction proven.

claim: GBP/USD trades above 1.2950 at least once intraday before 2026-06-10 as BP North Sea exit headlines amplify sterling risk premium.
falsification_criteria: Falsified if GBP/USD does not trade at or above 1.2950 on any intraday print from 2026-06-04 through 2026-06-10.
grading_note: A full BP North Sea exit crystallises the fiscal and current-account optics for the UK at a moment when Labour's windfall-tax credibility is already questioned; sterling is the natural pressure valve, but the move depends on how loudly the story runs.

claim: HSBC Holdings (HSBA.L) underperforms the FTSE 100 by at least 3 percentage points on a total-return basis by 2026-07-03.
falsification_criteria: Falsified if HSBA.L total return from 2026-06-03 through 2026-07-03 is within 3 percentage points of the FTSE 100 total return, or outperforms it.
grading_note: After a 69% annual run the implied assumptions leave no margin for error; any softness in Asia credit or Hong Kong property data in the next four weeks will be read as a thesis-breaker at this valuation, triggering mean-reversion against an index with less stretched positioning.

claim: Brent crude settles above $82/bbl on Friday 2026-06-05, as Gulf geopolitical premium holds after the Kuwait and Gulf of Oman incidents.
falsification_criteria: Brent crude front-month settles at or below $82.00/bbl on 2026-06-05.
grading_note: Brent crude closed at $97.20/bbl on 2026-06-05; well above the $82.00 threshold, falsification criteria not met.

claim: Rolls-Royce (RR. LN) closes the week of 2026-06-05–06-11 within 3% of its current level — the 40% YTD run stalls as profit-takers dominate ahead of no scheduled catalysts.
falsification_criteria: Rolls-Royce shares move more than 3% (up or down) from their 2026-06-04 close by 2026-06-11 market close.
grading_note: A 40% surge in a FTSE 100 industrial without an imminent earnings release or deal announcement typically consolidates; momentum buyers have already been rewarded and there is no clear near-term re-rating trigger.

claim: GBP/USD trades above 1.2850 at New York close on 2026-06-11, as the Barclays fee-cut announcement signals UK consumer resilience and the dollar softens on stagflation ambiguity.
falsification_criteria: GBP/USD fixes at or below 1.2850 at the New York close on 2026-06-11.
grading_note: Dallas Fed's Logan floating a rate hike is hawkish on its face but stagflationary Beige Book data undermines clean dollar bull conviction; sterling benefits from any dollar ambiguity while UK domestic data remains firmer than feared.

claim: Broadcom (AVGO) closes above $195 by 2026-06-11 following HSBC's raised price target, outperforming the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index (SOX) by at least 2 percentage points on the week.
falsification_criteria: AVGO closes at or below $195, or its weekly return trails the SOX weekly return by less than 2 percentage points, as of 2026-06-11 close.
grading_note: HSBC's raised target citing hyperscaler custom-chip demand is a concrete institutional catalyst; Broadcom's custom-ASIC exposure is structurally differentiated from commodity AI infrastructure plays and should attract rotation out of pure-play GPU names.

claim: AstraZeneca (AZN LN) gains at least 4% from its 2026-06-04 close by 2026-07-04 as the positive liver cancer survival data accelerates investor re-rating of its oncology pipeline.
falsification_criteria: AstraZeneca shares close below a level 4% above their 2026-06-04 close at any point through 2026-07-04.
grading_note: Hepatocellular carcinoma is a high-unmet-need indication with limited approved second-line options; a credible survival signal in a major pharma trial reliably prompts institutional upgrades and pipeline valuation step-ups within weeks of disclosure.

claim: The US 2s10s Treasury yield curve steepens to +25 basis points or wider by 2026-07-04, as Logan's rate-hike rhetoric lifts the front end less than long-end coal/deficit spending fears lift the back end.
falsification_criteria: The US 2s10s spread remains below +25 basis points through 2026-07-04 close.
grading_note: The White House's $700m coal commitment and ongoing deficit spending widen the term premium on long bonds; simultaneously, Logan's hike rhetoric anchors the short end but cannot fully offset fiscal anxiety — the net is a steeper curve, not a parallel shift.

claim: BP's ADR (BP) closes below its June 5 close on June 6 as the restructuring announcement disappoints without specific asset-sale timelines or financial targets.
falsification_criteria: BP ADR closes at or above its June 5 closing price on June 6.
grading_note: BP's June 5, 2026 close confirmed at approximately $42.97–$44.04, but June 6, 2026 closing price could not be definitively located despite extensive searching of financial data sources.

claim: HSBC ADR (HSBC) closes below its June 5 close at the June 12 market close.
falsification_criteria: HSBC ADR closes at or above its June 5 closing price at the June 12 New York close.
grading_note: The mainland-client account closures strip away the core growth narrative HSBC has used to justify its Asia pivot; institutional holders who owned HSBC for that optionality will reassess, and Beijing's tightening posture is unlikely to reverse inside a week.

claim: USD/JPY closes lower at the June 12 New York fix than at the June 5 New York fix.
falsification_criteria: USD/JPY at the June 12 NY fix is at or above its June 5 NY fix level.
grading_note: Fed's Schmid flagging unsustainable debt costs and Daly downplaying AI's near-term inflation role both erode the yield-support narrative that has kept dollar longs comfortable; latent yen carry unwinds remain the path of least resistance if risk appetite wobbles.

claim: Neither Boeing nor Airbus publicly announces a signed wide-body order from Qantas before July 5, 2026.
falsification_criteria: Boeing or Airbus issues an official press release confirming a signed Qantas wide-body order before July 5.
grading_note: Qantas is running a competitive dual-track process; the reported language — 'evaluating roughly 20 aircraft' and 'opening talks' — places this weeks to months from signature, and Qantas has a long history of drawn-out fleet negotiations.

claim: Unilever ADR (UL) closes below 103% of its June 5 closing price on July 5, 2026 — the structural headwind thesis prevails over the value-reversion case.
falsification_criteria: Unilever ADR closes at or above 103% of its June 5 closing price on July 5.
grading_note: A 17% drawdown in a consumer staples name is seductive as a value entry, but private-label competition, volume softness, and activist ESG moves that are now backfiring (see Sainsbury's eggs) suggest the multiple compression is structural rather than mean-reverting.

claim: Nasdaq Composite closes up ≥1% on 2026-06-07, recovering a portion of today's jobs-driven selloff.
falsification_criteria: Nasdaq Composite closing gain is below 1% — including any flat or negative close — on 2026-06-07.
grading_note: June 7, 2026 is a Sunday — U.S. stock markets are closed and there is no Nasdaq Composite close that day. Data cannot be resolved.

claim: US 10-year Treasury yield closes above 4.50% on 2026-06-10, sustained by the strong payrolls repricing of Fed cut expectations.
falsification_criteria: The 10-year yield closes at or below 4.50% on 2026-06-10.
grading_note: Strong payrolls data has materially pushed out the expected first Fed cut; the bond market has not yet fully digested a scenario where the Fed holds through October, which Warsh — if confirmed — may reinforce.

claim: Caterpillar (CAT) outperforms the S&P 500 by ≥2 percentage points over the week ending 2026-06-13.
falsification_criteria: CAT's weekly return trails the S&P 500's weekly return by any amount, or outperforms by less than 2 percentage points.
grading_note: CAT's record $63bn backlog and raised 2026 outlook position it as a defensive growth name; in a week where rate fears punish long-duration tech, industrial stalwarts with tangible order books tend to rotate into favor.

claim: EUR/USD trades above 1.1000 at least once intraday between 2026-06-09 and 2026-06-13.
falsification_criteria: EUR/USD does not print 1.1000 or higher on any intraday tick from 2026-06-09 through 2026-06-13.
grading_note: Dollar strength post-payrolls is the consensus trade, making a contrarian EUR squeeze plausible if ECB rhetoric turns less dovish or US credit stress data disappoints; the 1.10 level is psychologically magnetic for options positioning.

claim: Tapestry (TPR) shares close higher than today's close on at least three of the next five trading sessions through 2026-06-13.
falsification_criteria: TPR closes above today's level on fewer than three of the five trading sessions ending 2026-06-13.
grading_note: Post-earnings dips on solid underlying demographic trends historically attract value buyers within the week; Coach's Gen Z penetration story is not a one-quarter narrative, and the selloff creates a well-publicized entry point.

claim: C3.ai (AI) shares fall ≥8% from today's close by 2026-07-06 as widening losses and the Shell partnership fail to reassure growth investors.
falsification_criteria: C3.ai shares on 2026-07-06 are less than 8% below today's closing price.
grading_note: Enterprise AI names with widening net losses trade on revenue acceleration narratives; C3.ai's $250m revenue alongside expanding losses in a higher-for-longer rate environment removes the multiple-expansion catalyst that sustained the stock.
